2. As per the submission of Mr. Dash, learned Addl P.P. the notice/intimation for hearing of bail application as well as the appeal has been served on the informant/ victim on 11 th March 2025.
No one entered appearance for the informant/ victim.

3. The Appellant namely, Makara Mallick who is convicted for commission of offences under Section 376(2)(i)/ 363 of the Indian Penal Code and read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years along with fine by learned Adhoc Additional District and Sessions Judge,
FTSC(POCSO), Jagatsinghpur in his judgment dated 13th August 2024 has prayed to release him on bail pending appeal.
4.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Upon hearing both parties and considering the evidences of the witnesses including the victim (P.W.1) and the circumstances, it is directed to release the Appellant-Petitioner on bail pending appeal on such terms and conditions to be fixed by the learned Adhoc Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC(POCSO), Jagatsinghpur in connection with Spl. G.R. Case No. 06 of 2016 arising out of Kujang P.S. Case No.46 of 2016.
7. There shall be stay of realization of fine amount as imposed by learned learned Adhoc Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC(POCSO), Jagatsinghpur in the impugned judgment dated 13th August 2024 till disposal of the appeal.
9. An urgent certified copy of this order shall be issued on proper application.
